name: Ono Chiyo
source:
Chiyo loves sweets and eating them makes her happier than anything else. She also enjoys making sweets and pastries. She has a habit of eating too much and often worries about her weight. Chiyo is also very clumsy; she tends to drop things and frequently trips.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
